title: Mountain Witch's Cutlery
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, Genta, Haibara, Agasa) omitted by convention, matching the old case file's own note. The old lower-fidelity file's culprit (Raito Adachi / s2) and weapon mechanism (obsidian shard broken off with a hammer) both check out against the full transcript -- no reversal found here. The upgrade over the old file is fidelity, not correction: generic 'knows' edges replaced with real typed relationships (host_client, grandchild_of, coworker) and a `defrauds` backstory edge explaining the motive; event nodes decomposed into direct verb edges (steals, fashions_weapon_from, kills, drags_body_of, hides_weapon_in, leaves_evidence) with circumstance_tags (locked_room, staged_alibi); the second red herring (Kahara Fuuga, who is secretly the homeowner's grandson Tanaka Shouta in disguise) is fully modeled including his own backstory arc, but note he has no `has_motive_against` edge toward the victim -- the transcript never gives him one, his suspicion arises purely from concealing his identity, so none was invented; the third arc (Iwae Tanaka's hidden, sharpened red-handled cutlery for her absent grandson) is restored as its own object/clue thread even though it turns out to be unrelated to the murder weapon. Raito's real name is never disclosed in the available transcript -- he is interrupted mid-reveal -- so `Adachi Raito` (his host-club stage name) is kept as his only known name, noted in attrs. case_type: murder.
